AURA logo candidates

Every AURA logo, glyph, mark and icon found on this machine — Projects, Documents, Academia, Desktop, Downloads, Pictures, Sites. Each is shown on light and dark grounds, and at the three sizes the site header uses. Confirm one by number.

Correction

The site currently uses 09, the four-arc aura-logo.svg, because it was in the site repo. That appears to be the wrong file. 01 is a 12,076 × 8,312 master that appears in three separate locations, which is what a canonical logo looks like. The site's colour palette was derived from 09's gradients and will be rederived from whichever mark you confirm.

  • 01 for the site header.
  • 02 for the footer and OG cards — it carries the William & Mary lockup.
  • Both are raster. On confirmation I will trace the glyph to SVG so it holds at 20 px in the nav and at poster size, and cut a favicon from it.
  • The vector alternates (04–08) need no tracing if you prefer one of those.
